entries.name: Auto_Zero_Length
entries.comment:
Apply function creates extra points/nodes in Layer: AutoZL at the region
	where existed points/nodes meet the topology criteria selected below.
	Zero length elements will be then applied between existed model
	points/nodes and extra auto made points/nodes.
	Clear function deletes every extra point from layer: AutoZL as well as
	zero length conditions applied by the Apply function.

	DO NOT FORGET TO UPDATE WINDOW FOR EVERY MODIFICATION.

entries.name: Point_Restraints
entries.comment:
This condition is assigned on points and is transferred on nodes.
	\It is recommended to apply restraints in the FIRST interval only.
	After assigning new restraints DO NOT FORGET to regenerate the mesh.

You can assign this condition using the defined records from the Records window.
	Ground motion is applied always applied in the ACTIVE interval.
	After assigning new ground motion DO NOT FORGET to regenerate the mesh.

entries.name: Point_Sine_Ground_Motion

entries.name: Point_Equal_constraint_master_node
entries.comment:
You must assign this condition to ONE point that will be the master node for the selected ID. 
	Each equal constraint group should have a unique ID.
	\It is recommended to apply equal constraints in the FIRST interval only.
	After assigning new constraints DO NOT FORGET to regenerate the mesh.

fields.name: Equal_constraint_ID
fields.help_text: Give a positive integer number for body constraint group.

entries.name: Point_Equal_constraint_slave_nodes
entries.comment:
You can assign this condition to more than 1 points/nodes, for each equal constraint ID.
	Each equal constraint group should have a unique ID.
	For more than 1 points/nodes, the constraint is applied in point/node pairs.
	\It is recommended to apply equal constraints in the FIRST interval only.
	After assigning new constraints DO NOT FORGET to regenerate the mesh.

fields.name: Equal_constraint_ID
fields.help_text: Give a positive integer number for body constraint group.

entries.name: Line_Equal_constraint_slave_nodes
entries.comment:
Line constraints will be transferred to all respective line nodes.
	It is recommended to use this condition in case of fine line mesh that more than 2 nodes will be generated.
	Each equal constraint group should have a unique ID.
	\It is recommended to apply line constraints in the FIRST interval only.
	After assigning new constraints DO NOT FORGET to regenerate the mesh.

fields.name: Equal_constraint_ID
fields.help_text: Enter a positive integer number for the equal constraint.

fields.name: Rigid_link_ID

fields.name: Rigid_link_ID
fields.help_text: Give a positive integer number for body constraint group.

entries.name: Point_Rigid_diaphragm_master_node
entries.comment:
This condition must be assigned to ONE point that will be the master node for the selected ID group. 
	Each rigid diaphragm must have a unique ID.
	The rigid plane can be selected on the corresponding condition for slave nodes
	In Interval data, a 'Transformation' or 'Lagrange' constraint handler type should be selected.
	\It is recommended to apply rigid diaphragms in the FIRST interval only.
	Master node fixities are automatically assigned depending on the rigid plane.
	After assigning new constraints DO NOT FORGET to regenerate the mesh.

entries.name: Line_Rayleigh_Damping-Elements
entries.comment:
This condition is used to assign rayleigh damping parameters to line elements.
	It includes all these elements and all the connected nodes.
	It is assigned to lines and is transferred to line elements.
	Region IDs must be SEPERATE between Element and Node Damping.
	After assigning new damping DO NOT FORGET to regenerate the mesh.

entries.name: Surface_Rayleigh_Damping-Elements
entries.comment:
This condition is used to assign rayleigh damping parameters to surface elements.
	It includes all these elements and all the connected nodes.
	It is assigned to surfaces and is transferred to surface elements.
	Region IDs must be SEPERATE between Element and Node Damping.
	After assigning new damping DO NOT FORGET to regenerate the mesh.

entries.comment:
This condition is used to assign rayleigh damping parameters to nodes.
	It includes all these nodes and all elements of which all nodes are selected.
	It is assigned to points and is transferred to the corresponding nodes.
	Region IDs must be SEPERATE between Element and Node Damping.
	After assigning new damping DO NOT FORGET to regenerate the mesh.

entries.name: Point_ZeroLength
entries.comment:
Each group of ZeroLength elements must have a unique ID.
	Each ZeroLength ID must be assigned on at least 2 points/nodes with the same coordinates.
	For more than 2 points/nodes, the element is applied in point/node pairs.
	Zero Length Element's Nodes must have same dof.
	After assigning new zero length elements DO NOT FORGET to regenerate the mesh.

entries.name: Line_Beam_contact_master_end_nodes
entries.comment:
This condition is applied to lines and assigned to their body elements.
	These lines should be meshed at 1 only linear element!

entries.name: Point_Beam_contact_slave_nodes
entries.comment:
This condition is applied to points and assigned to nodes.
	Assign this condition in the corresponding interval
	you want to activate contact.

entries.name: Point_Body_constraint_master_node
entries.comment:
You must assign this condition to ONE point that will be the master node for the selected ID. 
	Each body constraint group should have a unique positive integer ID number.
	\It is recommended to apply body constraints in the FIRST interval only.
	After assigning new constraints DO NOT FORGET to regenerate the mesh.

fields.name: Body_constraint_ID_number
fields.help_text: Give a positive integer number for body constraint group.

entries.name: Point_Body_constraint_slave_nodes
entries.comment:
You can assign this condition to more than 1 points/nodes, for each body constraint ID.
	Each body constraint group should have a unique positive integer ID number.
	For more than 1 points/nodes, the constraint is applied in point/node pairs.
	\It is recommended to apply body constraints in the FIRST interval only.
	After assigning new constraints DO NOT FORGET to regenerate the mesh.

fields.name: Body_constraint_ID_number
fields.help_text: Give a positive integer number for body constraint group.

entries.name: Line_Body_constraint_slave_nodes
entries.comment:
Line constraints will be transferred to all respective line nodes.
	It is recommended to use this condition in case of fine line mesh that more than 2 nodes will be generated.
	Each body constraint group should have a unique positive integer ID number.
	\It is recommended to apply line constraints in the FIRST interval only.
	After assigning new constraints DO NOT FORGET to regenerate the mesh.

fields.name: Line_constraint_ID_number
fields.help_text: Enter a positive integer number for the body constraint.

entries.name: ZeroLength
entries.comment:
Each group of ZeroLength elements must have a unique integer ID number.
	Each ZeroLength ID must be assigned on at least 2 points/nodes with the same coordinates.
	For more than 2 points/nodes, the element is applied in point/node pairs.
	Zero Length Element's Nodes must have same dof.
	After assigning new zero length elements DO NOT FORGET to regenerate the mesh.
